protocol.purpose: Optimize a feasible positive fixed-N ensemble directly, with affine density constraints and a reduced-space primal-dual certificate
protocol.initialization: Restore the saved feasible ensembles and exact compiled response spaces; do not repeat their construction or use the molecular potential
protocol.primal_objective: Zero-temperature Tr Gamma(T+W), Gamma positive, unit trace and exact spatial density constraints
protocol.mathematics: ADMM and affine SVD projection are numerical primitives, not novelty claims; acceptance checks actual feasibility and a primal-dual energy gap
protocol.failure_policy: Retain a feasible upper energy estimate and return no XC scalar/potential when stationarity or global checks fail
protocol.assessment: Saved oracle universal values are accessed only after prediction stops; no reference-error objective or setting sweeps
